summary: The agent failed because it skipped the mandatory test discovery step (Step 1 in SKILL.md), built the workbook blindly, ran only custom verification, and declared success without ever running pytest. The existing skill already documents this anti-pattern, but the agent ignored it. This update strengthens the existing skill by: (1) making test discovery a hard gate with explicit failure consequences, (2) adding a robust assumption-parsing pattern to prevent KeyError from brittle row ranges, (3) clarifying the defined names iteration API with a ready-to-use snippet, and (4) adding a new reference on assumption parsing patterns extracted from the Grwth parsing failure.
